scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api start" "npm --prefix web start"
scripts.start:mongo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run start:mongo" "npm --prefix web start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web start"
scripts.dev:mongo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev:mongo" "npm --prefix web start"
